features.name: System Uptime Guarantee
features.description: Maintain 99.5% uptime measured monthly, excluding planned maintenance windows

requirementDetails.userStory: As a user of the car rental platform, I want the system to be available when I need it and to handle errors gracefully, so that I can complete bookings reliably without disruption or data loss.
acceptanceCriteria: System is available 99.5% of time (approximately 3.6 hours downtime per month)
Planned maintenance windows are scheduled during low-traffic periods
Users are notified of planned maintenance at least 48 hours in advance
Uptime is measured and reported monthly
Uptime SLA is documented and communicated

features.name: Critical Path Availability Priority
features.description: Prioritize availability of critical booking and payment paths over non-essential features with 99.9% availability

requirementDetails.userStory: As a user, I want core booking and payment features to remain available even during partial outages.
acceptanceCriteria: Vehicle search remains available during partial outages
Booking creation remains available during partial outages
Payment processing remains available during partial outages
Non-critical features (recommendations, analytics) may degrade gracefully
Critical path availability exceeds 99.9%

features.name: Planned Maintenance Management
features.description: Minimize user impact during planned maintenance through scheduling and communication

requirementDetails.userStory: As a user, I want to be informed of maintenance windows in advance so I can plan accordingly.
acceptanceCriteria: Maintenance windows are scheduled during lowest-traffic periods
Maintenance duration does not exceed 4 hours
Users receive 48-hour advance notice
Maintenance status page shows current status
Critical fixes can be deployed with minimal downtime

features.name: Graceful Error Handling
features.description: Handle errors gracefully without exposing sensitive information or crashing the system

requirementDetails.userStory: As a user, I want clear error messages that help me understand and resolve issues.
acceptanceCriteria: User-facing error messages are clear and actionable
Technical error details are logged but not displayed to users
Errors do not expose sensitive data or system internals
Application continues functioning after non-critical errors
Error boundaries prevent cascading failures in UI

features.name: Comprehensive Error Logging and Monitoring
features.description: Log all errors with sufficient context for diagnosis and resolution with centralized logging

requirementDetails.userStory: As a platform operator, I want comprehensive error logging to diagnose and fix issues quickly.
acceptanceCriteria: Errors include timestamp, user ID, request ID, and stack trace
Error severity levels are assigned (critical, error, warning)
Critical errors trigger immediate alerts
Error logs are centralized and searchable
Error trends are analyzed for proactive fixes

features.name: User Error Recovery Paths
features.description: Provide clear recovery paths when users encounter errors with preserved form data

requirementDetails.userStory: As a user encountering an error, I want clear guidance on how to resolve it.
acceptanceCriteria: Error messages explain what went wrong
Error messages suggest corrective actions
Users can retry failed operations
Form data is preserved after errors
Support contact information is readily available

features.name: Database Failover Automation
features.description: Automatically failover to replica database when primary fails within 60 seconds

requirementDetails.userStory: As a platform operator, I want automatic database failover to maintain service during database failures.
acceptanceCriteria: Database replication is configured with automatic failover
Failover completes within 60 seconds
No data loss occurs during failover (synchronous replication)
Application automatically reconnects to new primary
Failover events are logged and alerted

features.name: Application Redundancy with Load Balancing
features.description: Deploy multiple application instances behind load balancer for redundancy and zero-downtime deployments

requirementDetails.userStory: As a platform operator, I want redundant application instances to prevent single points of failure.
acceptanceCriteria: At least 2 application instances run at all times
Load balancer distributes traffic across healthy instances
Health checks detect and remove unhealthy instances
New instances can be added without downtime
Session state is not tied to specific instances

features.name: Circuit Breaker Pattern Implementation
features.description: Implement circuit breakers to prevent cascading failures when external services fail

requirementDetails.userStory: As a platform operator, I want circuit breakers to prevent cascading failures from external service issues.
acceptanceCriteria: Circuit breakers protect calls to external services
Circuit opens after threshold of failures (e.g., 5 in 10 seconds)
Circuit half-opens after timeout to test recovery
Fallback behavior is defined for open circuits
Circuit breaker state is monitored and alerted

features.name: Intelligent Retry Logic
features.description: Implement intelligent retry logic with exponential backoff for transient failures

requirementDetails.userStory: As a user, I want the system to automatically retry failed operations when appropriate.
acceptanceCriteria: Transient failures are retried with exponential backoff
Maximum retry attempts are configured (e.g., 3 attempts)
Idempotent operations are safe to retry
Non-idempotent operations use idempotency keys
Retry attempts are logged for monitoring

features.name: Transaction Consistency with ACID Properties
features.description: Ensure data consistency through database transactions with ACID properties

requirementDetails.userStory: As a platform operator, I want transactional consistency to prevent data corruption.
acceptanceCriteria: Database transactions ensure ACID properties
Failed transactions are rolled back completely
Partial updates do not leave data in inconsistent state
Transaction isolation prevents race conditions
Deadlocks are detected and resolved

features.name: Saga Pattern for Distributed Transactions
features.description: Use Saga pattern to manage distributed transactions across microservices with compensating transactions

sources.section: REQ-REL-12: Saga Pattern for Distributed Transactions

requirementDetails.userStory: As a platform operator with microservices, I want reliable distributed transactions without distributed locks.
acceptanceCriteria: Saga coordinator manages multi-service transactions
Compensating transactions rollback on failure
Saga state is persisted for recovery
Saga execution is idempotent
Saga failures are logged and alerted

features.name: Comprehensive Data Validation
features.description: Validate all data at input and storage boundaries to prevent corruption

requirementDetails.userStory: As a platform operator, I want comprehensive data validation to maintain data quality.
acceptanceCriteria: Input validation occurs on client and server
Database constraints enforce data integrity
Invalid data is rejected with clear error messages
Data type and format validation is comprehensive
Business rule validation prevents invalid states

features.name: Automated Backup and Recovery
features.description: Implement automated backup and recovery procedures with RTO of 4 hours and RPO of 24 hours

requirementDetails.userStory: As a platform operator, I want automated backups to prevent data loss.
acceptanceCriteria: Database backups occur daily at minimum
Backups are stored in geographically separate location
Backup integrity is verified regularly
Recovery procedures are documented and tested
Recovery Time Objective (RTO) is 4 hours or less
Recovery Point Objective (RPO) is 24 hours or less

features.name: Timeout Configuration for External Calls
features.description: Configure appropriate timeouts for all external calls to prevent indefinite blocking

requirementDetails.userStory: As a platform operator, I want timeouts to prevent indefinite blocking on slow services.
acceptanceCriteria: HTTP requests have timeouts (e.g., 30 seconds)
Database queries have timeouts (e.g., 10 seconds)
External API calls have timeouts (e.g., 15 seconds)
Timeout values are configurable
Timeout errors are handled gracefully

features.name: Rate Limiting Protection
features.description: Implement rate limiting to protect against overload and abuse

requirementDetails.userStory: As a platform operator, I want rate limiting to protect system resources from overload.
acceptanceCriteria: Rate limits are configured per endpoint and user type
Rate limit violations return 429 Too Many Requests
Rate limit headers inform clients of limits
Rate limiting does not impact legitimate users
Rate limits are monitored and adjusted as needed

features.name: Bulkhead Pattern for Resource Isolation
features.description: Isolate critical resources to prevent resource exhaustion from affecting all operations

requirementDetails.userStory: As a platform operator, I want resource isolation to prevent cascading resource exhaustion.
acceptanceCriteria: Database connection pools are sized appropriately
Thread pools are isolated for different operation types
Resource exhaustion in one area does not affect others
Resource utilization is monitored
Resource limits are configurable

features.name: Health Check Endpoints
features.description: Implement health check endpoints for monitoring system status and automated traffic routing

requirementDetails.userStory: As a platform operator, I want health checks to enable automated monitoring and traffic routing.
acceptanceCriteria: Health check endpoint returns system status
Health checks verify database connectivity
Health checks verify external service connectivity
Health checks complete within 5 seconds
Load balancers use health checks to route traffic

features.name: Proactive Monitoring and Alerting
features.description: Monitor key reliability metrics and alert operators of issues before they impact users

requirementDetails.userStory: As a platform operator, I want proactive monitoring to detect issues before they significantly impact users.
acceptanceCriteria: Error rates are monitored in real-time
Response times are monitored continuously
Resource utilization (CPU, memory, disk) is tracked
Alerts trigger when thresholds are exceeded
Alert fatigue is minimized through intelligent thresholds

features.name: Incident Response Procedures
features.description: Maintain documented incident response procedures for reliability issues with on-call rotation

requirementDetails.userStory: As a platform operator, I want structured incident response to minimize downtime.
acceptanceCriteria: Incident response plan is documented
On-call rotation is established
Incident severity levels are defined
Escalation procedures are clear
Post-incident reviews identify improvements

features.name: Zero-Downtime Deployments
features.description: Enable deployments without user-facing downtime using blue-green or rolling deployment strategies

requirementDetails.userStory: As a platform operator, I want zero-downtime deployments to enable frequent updates without disrupting users.
acceptanceCriteria: Blue-green or rolling deployment strategy is used
Database migrations are backward compatible
API changes are backward compatible
Deployments can be rolled back quickly
Deployment process is automated and tested

features.name: Deployment Validation and Gradual Rollout
features.description: Validate deployment success before routing traffic with smoke tests and gradual traffic shifting

requirementDetails.userStory: As a platform operator, I want deployment validation to catch issues before they affect all users.
acceptanceCriteria: Smoke tests run after deployment
Health checks verify new version is healthy
Traffic is gradually shifted to new version
Metrics are monitored during rollout
Automatic rollback occurs if issues are detected

features.name: Configuration Management
features.description: Manage configuration separately from code to enable changes without redeployment

requirementDetails.userStory: As a platform operator, I want externalized configuration to enable operational flexibility.
acceptanceCriteria: Configuration is externalized from application code
Configuration changes do not require redeployment
Configuration is versioned and audited
Configuration rollback is possible
Sensitive configuration is encrypted

features.name: Disaster Recovery Plan
features.description: Maintain documented and tested disaster recovery plan with defined RTO and RPO

requirementDetails.userStory: As a platform operator, I want a disaster recovery plan to ensure business continuity.
acceptanceCriteria: Disaster recovery plan is documented
Recovery procedures are tested annually
Recovery Time Objective (RTO) is defined and achievable
Recovery Point Objective (RPO) is defined and achievable
Disaster recovery team is identified and trained

features.name: Geographic Redundancy
features.description: Implement geographic redundancy for disaster recovery with data replication to separate regions

requirementDetails.userStory: As a platform operator, I want geographic redundancy to protect against regional disasters.
acceptanceCriteria: Critical data is replicated to geographically separate region
Failover to backup region is possible
Failover procedures are documented and tested
Data consistency is maintained across regions
Failover completes within defined RTO

features.name: Microservices Service Independence
features.description: Ensure service failures do not cascade to other services through fault isolation

requirementDetails.userStory: As a platform operator with microservices, I want service independence to prevent cascading failures.
acceptanceCriteria: Services have independent failure domains
Service failures are isolated through circuit breakers
Degraded service functionality is maintained during partial failures
Service dependencies are minimized
Service mesh provides fault isolation

features.name: Distributed Tracing
features.description: Implement distributed tracing for debugging and monitoring in microservices architectures

requirementDetails.userStory: As a platform operator with microservices, I want distributed tracing to debug issues across services.
acceptanceCriteria: Correlation IDs track requests across services
Distributed tracing captures request flow
Trace data is collected and visualized
Performance bottlenecks are identified through traces
Error propagation is visible in traces
